name: io.github.pablocaeg/sloptotal
title: SlopTotal
description: Open-source AI text detector: 23 engines, one calibrated score. Checks texts, pages and sites.

runtimeArguments.name: --add-host
runtimeArguments.description: Lets the container reach a SlopTotal server running on this machine (needed on Linux; harmless on Docker Desktop).

environmentVariables.name: SLOPTOTAL_URL
environmentVariables.description: SlopTotal server to call. Default http://host.docker.internal:8000, a self-hosted server on this machine (docker run -p 8000:8000 ghcr.io/pablocaeg/sloptotal), so the text stays local. https://api.sloptotal.com sends the text to sloptotal.com.

environmentVariables.name: SLOPTOTAL_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Seconds to wait for a queued scan before giving up.
